milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the birch log tree and face it to demonstrate they have found it. Target is the birch log tree trunk at spawn-relative (5, 2, 4), with max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 to model 'player can see the birch logs'.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a wooden_hoe results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player must harvest birch logs, craft planks, craft sticks, then craft the wooden hoe at a crafting table. The definitive proof of successful crafting is having the item in inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the cartography table and face it to demonstrate they have located it. Target is the cartography table at spawn-relative (10, 0, 5), with max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 to model 'player can see the cartography table'.
